Add a colour legend

Source: R/legend.R
add_color_legend.Rd

Adds a legend that names the channels and their colours, like a ggplot2 legend: a coloured swatch next to each channel name, outside the panels. It lists the channels shown in the montage, including the members of merges; merges themselves are not listed. Black channels (shown inverted) are left out, since their swatches would all look the same; their colours in merges are listed instead. The montage grows by the space the legend needs, so the panels keep their size.

Usage

add_color_legend(
  montage,
  position = c("bottom", "top", "right"),
  size = 7,
  color = "black",
  ranges = TRUE
)

Arguments

montage

A tidymontage() object.

position

Where the legend goes: "bottom" (the default), "top" or "right".

size

Text size in points.

color

Text colour.

ranges

If TRUE, label colour bars with the display range.

Value

The montage with the legend step added.

Details

Channels and overlays coloured with a colormap (lut()) are shown with a colour bar instead of a swatch. With ranges = TRUE, the ends of a channel's bar are labelled with its display range (see adjust_exposure()). This needs one range for all images of the channel, which is the default; bars of channels with several ranges, and of overlays, are left unlabelled.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
montage |> add_color_legend("bottom")
} # }
